policy_name: Light Therapy, for Seasonal Affective Disorder (SAD)

conditions.description: Last 6 months of clinical notes from requesting provider and/or specialist

exclusions.description: There is insufficient evidence in the published medical literature to show that this service/therapy is as safe as standard services/therapies and/or provides better long-term outcomes than current standard services/therapies.
The use of light therapy in the treatment of Seasonal Affective Disorder (SAD) does not meet the Kaiser Permanente Medical Technology Assessment Criteria.
HCPCS codes E0203 (Therapeutic lightbox, minimum 10,000 lux, table top model) and A4634 (Replacement bulb for therapeutic light box, tabletop model) are considered not covered.

conditions.value: See the Noridian Non-Covered Items for HCPC code E0203
